Name: Smaller Cuter Doghouse or Pet House (CP and AT Versions)
Author: glymr
Description:
This mod started when ¿DUDE? on the SVE Discord was wishing for a smaller, cuter doghouse. TricksyFox jumped to the rescue, creating multiple lovely new pet houses (and including a fun gif so we could see her progress along the way)! I offered to code the CP and AT versions, and here we are! Install either the Content Patcher or Alternative Textures version and enjoy smaller, cuter pet houses for your furry friends!

For the CP version, you can use the Generic Mod Config Menu to choose whether you want the pointed roof version, flat roof version, or to turn it off entirely.

For the AT version, you must purchase the paint can from Robin and click on the pet house while holding the paint can. The keywords are "smaller" and "cuter".

You can install both versions without conflict.

Let us know what other variations you'd like to see (recolor compatibility? a ball of a different color? a dark doghouse version?)
and we'll see what we can do. ^_^ Please track this mod if you want to be notified when we add other variations.

NEW! Now includes an i18n for the config menu and several new pet house options, including the dark doghouse versions and versions with and without the decorative ball! Feel free to make and post translations. We don't mind if you earn donation points with them, but this none of the assets from this mod may be included, only the translation file. If you make a CP translation, this mod must be a dependency.

You can check out glymr's other mods here: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/glymr/mods]https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/glymr/mods[/url]
